requirement_vague: Verify any authenticated user can update and delete any article (no authorization check - security vulnerability)

omissions.description: Authenticated non-owners cannot update any article; the code forbids updating articles unless the current user is the author.
omissions.reasoning: In PUT /api/articles/{slug}, after loading the article, the handler checks `if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")`. This prevents user2 from updating user1's article, contrary to the requirement to allow any authenticated user to update any article.

omissions.description: Authenticated non-owners cannot delete any article; the code forbids deleting articles unless the current user is the author.
omissions.reasoning: In DELETE /api/articles/{slug}, the handler checks `if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")`. This prevents user2 from deleting user1's article, contrary to the requirement to allow any authenticated user to delete any article.
